acceptedExactSameApplication.exactText:
have hUI (i : Fin n) : Integrable (fun ξ => U ξ i) P₀ := by
    have hUM : Measurable (fun ξ => U ξ i) := by
      change Measurable (fun ξ => R ξ i * cap ξ i * |A ξ - Adel ξ i|)
      have hAbsM : Measurable (fun ξ => |A ξ - Adel ξ i|) := by
        simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, Pi.sub_apply] using (hAM.sub (hAdelM i)).norm
      exact ((hRM i).mul (hcapM i)).mul hAbsM

acceptedRepeatedNormDifferenceApplicatio.exactText:
have hAbsI (i : Fin n) : Integrable
      (fun ξ => R ξ i * cap ξ i * abs (abs (D₁ ξ) - abs (D₁del ξ i))) P₀ := by
    have hAbsM : Measurable (fun ξ => abs (abs (D₁ ξ) - abs (D₁del ξ i))) := by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, Pi.sub_apply] using
        ((hDM.norm).sub ((hDdelM i).norm)).norm
    apply (hDI i).mono' (((hRM i).mul (hcapM i)).mul hAbsM).aestronglyMeasurable
